contexts.text: Near the bank of the river = in the boundaries. The river = the boundary.
She set it in the flag by the bank of the river = at first among false scientific things... the river of Egypt = what is false.

Stand to meet him near the bank of the river = influx according to the state... The bank of the river = the state of falsity in which were those who were infesting... The river of Egypt = what is false; here, falsity from fallacies; and the bank, which is as it were the containant, for it bends round and shuts it in, = the state of that falsity; for every one has its own state, in which, and according to which, it is.
